title: ductricity
description:
This repository designs a duct whose wall both shapes the flow into drafts and eddies and takes energy out of the flow it shaped.

Status: project definition only. No device has been built. No performance figure is claimed.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
